subject: nereid-pillar-three
q: CLOSED — IDOL WAS NEVER CARRIED INTO v8, SO THERE IS NOTHING TO MAP IT TO.
detail:
ANSWERED BY READING PILLAR THREE IN FULL, AND THE SUSPECTED ANSWER WAS THE RIGHT ONE. ASS HANDFEEL IN v8 IS NATURAL, DENSE, PLIANT, SPRINGY. There is no IDOL, no SHRINE, no RECOIL, no ANCHOR, AND NO MAPPING TABLE AT ALL — Pillar Three simply defines four values on their own terms and never mentions the retired vocabulary.

SO THE QUESTION DISSOLVES RATHER THAN RESOLVING. It assumed the mapping was a v8 structure with one row missing. THE MAPPING IS NOT IN v8. It is a bridge the Archive built to read v7 labels still sitting on live records, and IDOL has no row because IDOL was never an ass term — it appears on ARIANNA SOLENE’S 46-INCH HIPS, and hip labels do not translate through the handfeel table in either direction.

WHICH MAKES THIS THE CLEANEST CASE TONIGHT FOR NOT FILLING A GAP. A row invented for IDOL would have been an invention inside a bridge, describing a term the governing document does not contain, attached to a body part the table does not cover. THREE ERRORS IN ONE CELL.

PILLAR THREE SUPERSEDES, BY VIRAENA’S RULING. The mapping survives in the retired nereid-ass-field record as the only route from the old labels, and nothing more is owed to it.
